literal_meaning: ঘাটেরও নয়, ঘরেরও নয় (না নদীর তীরের অংশ, না বাড়ির অংশ)
figurative_meaning_en: A person who is unwelcome or out of place everywhere
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে না ঘাটকা না ঘরকা, কোথাও তার জায়গা নেই।
এই শহরে তার অবস্থা না ঘাটকা না ঘরকা হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is neither of the ghat nor the house; he has no place anywhere.
His situation in this city has become like neither ghat nor house, feeling out of place everywhere.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali life, where 'ghat' refers to riverbanks used for communal activities and 'ghar' to household, symbolizing someone who belongs nowhere in the social fabric.
note: The idiom reflects themes of social exclusion common in Bengali folklore.
